newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Airlines ups international fare.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Airlines ups international fare.

text.p: National carrier Malaysian Airline System Bhd (MAS), said it has raised a majority of its international air fares by three percent from Wednesday.

"Following the government's approval for Malaysia Airlines to increase our internaitonal fare by three percent, Malaysia Airlines has implemented this new fare structure effective January 15, 1997," MAS said in a statement.
Earlier this month, the government gave the airline permission to increase its international fares by between three and 10 percent.
Airlines around the region have implemented similar fare hikes due to rising jet fuel prices.
The International Air transport Association recommended the fare rise in November as jet fuel prices increased around 40 percent in 1996.
